Prompt Template: Write a friendly appointment confirmation message for [CLIENT NAME] booked for [SERVICE] on [DATE] at [TIME]. Include: service duration ([X] minutes), arrival time (10 min early), parking info if relevant, what to bring/prepare, and cancellation policy reminder. Warm and professional.

Write a 24-hour reminder message for [CLIENT NAME] coming in for [SERVICE] tomorrow at [TIME]. Include: brief prep instructions for [SERVICE TYPE], reminder to arrive [X] minutes early, and how to reschedule if needed. Keep it concise for text/SMS.

Write a caring message to [CLIENT NAME] who missed their appointment on [DATE]. Don't guilt-trip. Express concern, remind them of my cancellation policy (if charging), and invite them to rebook. Keep the relationship intact.

Write a message to waitlisted clients that an appointment opened up: [SERVICE] on [DATE] at [TIME]. Create urgency (first-come basis) without pressure. Include how to book and who to contact. Make it exciting, not desperate.

Write a welcome message for a new client [NAME] who just booked their first appointment for [SERVICE] on [DATE]. Include: what to expect, consultation process, parking/location details, and your excitement to meet them. Set a positive first impression.

Write a friendly reminder to [CLIENT NAME] who was in [X] weeks ago for [SERVICE]. It's time to rebook! Include: recommended rebooking timeframe for their service, available slots this week/next, and easy booking link. Not pushy, just helpful.

Write a message encouraging clients to book ahead for [HOLIDAY/SEASON - e.g., prom, wedding season, holidays]. Explain why booking early matters (availability, prep time). Include: available services, deadline to book, and how to secure their spot.

Write a message to [CLIENT NAME] who has [X] sessions remaining on their [PACKAGE NAME]. Remind them to use their sessions before [EXPIRATION DATE if applicable]. Suggest booking the remaining appointments now. Make it helpful, not salesy.

Write a birthday message to [CLIENT NAME] offering a special birthday treat: [OFFER - e.g., 20% off, free add-on service]. Valid for [TIMEFRAME]. Make them feel special and appreciated. Include booking CTA.

Write a clear, professional explanation of my cancellation policy to include in booking confirmations. Policy: [DESCRIBE - e.g., 24 hours notice required, late cancel fee $X, no-show fee $X]. Explain the reasoning kindly. Firm but not harsh.

Write aftercare instructions for [SERVICE: e.g., hair color, lash extensions, facial, waxing, microblading]. Include: immediate care (first 24-48 hours), products to use/avoid, activities to avoid, when to expect results to settle, and when to come back. Clear and thorough.

Write hair color aftercare instructions for a client who just got [COLOR SERVICE: highlights, balayage, all-over color, vivid colors]. Include: when to first wash, recommended products, how to extend color life, heat styling tips, and rebooking timeline.

Write comprehensive lash extension aftercare for a new lash client. Include: first 24-48 hours rules, daily care routine, what products to avoid, sleeping tips, how to clean them, when to come for fills, and signs of a reaction to watch for.

Write post-facial/treatment aftercare for [TREATMENT: chemical peel, microneedling, dermaplaning, LED therapy]. Include: what to expect (redness, sensitivity), products to use and avoid, sun protection requirements, makeup timing, and follow-up treatment schedule.

Write waxing aftercare instructions for [AREA: Brazilian, brows, legs, underarms]. Include: what to avoid (heat, friction, products), how to prevent ingrowns, soothing recommendations, and when to rebook (typically [X] weeks).

Write a personalized product recommendation for [CLIENT NAME] based on their [CONCERN: dry hair, oily skin, aging, acne, etc.]. Recommend [X] products from [BRAND/LINE]: explain what each does, how to use it, and why it addresses their specific needs.

Write at-home maintenance tips for clients between appointments. Service: [SERVICE TYPE]. Include: daily care routine, weekly treatments, products to invest in, what to avoid, and how to extend their results. Empower them without making them feel they don't need you.

Write a consultation summary for [CLIENT NAME]. Concerns discussed: [LIST]. Current routine: [DESCRIBE]. Recommendations: [LIST - services and products]. Treatment plan: [PROPOSED SCHEDULE]. Make it a useful reference document they can keep.

Write prep instructions for a client coming in for [SERVICE - e.g., spray tan, waxing, lash lift, brow lamination]. What to do before: [INSTRUCTIONS]. What to avoid: [LIST]. What to wear: [SUGGESTIONS]. What to expect: [BRIEF]. Help them get the best results.

Create a FAQ document for new clients. Answer the most common questions about: booking and policies, what to expect at first visit, payment options, tipping etiquette, parking, and how to prepare. Keep it friendly and informative.

Write a review request message to send [CLIENT NAME] after their appointment. Timing: send [X] hours/days after service. Include: genuine thanks, brief mention of the service, simple ask for a review, and direct link to [GOOGLE/YELP/FACEBOOK]. Make it easy and not awkward.

Write a short, friendly Google review request specifically. Include: direct link placeholder, brief instructions for those unfamiliar with leaving reviews, and why reviews help small businesses like mine. Keep it under 100 words for text/email.

Write a response to this positive review: "[REVIEW TEXT]". Thank them genuinely, reference something specific from their review, and invite them back. Professional but warm. Show personality without being over the top.

Write a professional response to this negative review: "[REVIEW TEXT]". Acknowledge their experience, apologize appropriately (without admitting fault if disputed), offer to make it right, and take the conversation offline. Stay calm and solution-focused.

Write a request to [CLIENT NAME] who has been a loyal client for [X] months/years asking for a testimonial I can use on my website/social media. Make it easy: offer to write something based on their feedback for their approval, or provide guiding questions.

Write a message asking [CLIENT NAME] for permission to share their [SERVICE] before/after photos on social media. Explain: how I'll use them, that I can keep them anonymous if preferred, and that I'd tag them only with permission. Make it feel flattering, not transactional.

Write an announcement about a review incentive program: clients who leave a review get [INCENTIVE - e.g., $10 off next service, entry into monthly drawing]. Include: where to leave reviews, how to claim incentive, and time period. Keep it compliant with platform rules.

Write a message to longtime clients asking them to share their experience/story for my website. Include: guiding questions (why they started coming, favorite service, how they feel after appointments), and reassurance that a few sentences is plenty.

Write an Instagram post showcasing [SERVICE]. Include: what the service is, who it's for, transformation it provides, duration and price (optional), and booking CTA. Add relevant hashtags for [CITY] beauty services. Keep it engaging, not just informational.

Write an engaging caption for a before/after transformation post. Service: [SERVICE]. Transformation: [DESCRIBE THE CHANGE]. Include: what the client wanted, how we achieved it, and products/techniques used. Make followers want the same results. Hashtags included.

Write 5 slides for an Instagram carousel educating followers about [SERVICE]. Slide 1: hook ("What is [SERVICE]?"). Slides 2-4: benefits, process, who it's for. Slide 5: CTA to book. Keep each slide under 30 words for readability.

Write a behind-the-scenes post about [TOPIC: my workspace, my tools, my process, a day in my life]. Make it personal and relatable. Help followers feel connected to me as a person, not just a service provider. Light and authentic tone.

Write a promotional post for my monthly special: [OFFER - e.g., 20% off facials, free brow wax with any color service]. Valid: [DATES]. Include: what's included, value, urgency, and how to book. Make it compelling without being desperate.

Write a [HOLIDAY/SEASON] themed post for my beauty business. Include: seasonal service recommendations, gift card mention if relevant, holiday hours, and booking reminder. Festive but professional. Examples: Valentine's Day glam, summer skin prep, holiday party ready.

Write a client appreciation post thanking my amazing clients. Could be: milestone celebration (X years in business), reaching X followers, or just because. Be genuine. No selling. Just gratitude. Make clients feel valued.

Write an announcement post for a new service I'm offering: [SERVICE NAME]. Include: what it is, benefits, who it's perfect for, introductory price (if applicable), and how to book. Generate excitement. Include a launch offer if: [OFFER].

Write a script for a quick Instagram Reel answering a common question: "[QUESTION - e.g., How long do lash extensions last? / Does waxing hurt? / How often should I get a facial?]". 15-30 seconds. Hook, answer, CTA. Casual and helpful.

Write a post sharing my professional take on a trending beauty topic: [TREND - e.g., skinimalism, cold girl makeup, DIY treatments, TikTok beauty hacks]. Share educated opinion, correct misinformation if needed, and position myself as an expert. Not preachy.

Write 5 Instagram Story engagement prompts for beauty businesses. Examples: polls (this or that), questions (hair goals?), quizzes (test your skincare knowledge), sliders (how badly do you need a facial?). Drive interaction and showcase personality.

Write a monthly email newsletter for my beauty business. Include: greeting, what's new this month (services, products), featured promotion, beauty tip, and booking CTA. Keep it scannable, under 300 words. Warm and professional.

Write an email/message announcing a price increase to existing clients. Current prices: [LIST]. New prices: [LIST]. Effective: [DATE]. Option to book at old rate before [DATE]. Explain: increased costs, continued quality commitment. Grateful and professional tone.

Write a closure notice for [REASON: vacation, renovation, maternity leave, etc.]. Closed dates: [DATES]. Include: when booking reopens, how to get on the waitlist, emergency contact if applicable, and excitement to return. Plan ahead messaging.

Write an announcement about a policy change: [DESCRIBE CHANGE - e.g., new deposit requirement, updated cancellation policy, no children in salon]. Explain the reason without over-explaining. Be clear and firm but kind. Effective date: [DATE].

Write a notice that I'm discontinuing [SERVICE]. Reason (if sharing): [OPTIONAL]. Last day to book: [DATE]. Alternative recommendations: [IF ANY]. Thank clients who loved this service. Focus on what I do offer going forward.

Write an announcement for my referral program. Offer: [DESCRIBE - e.g., $20 off for both referrer and new client]. Include: how it works, how to refer, any terms/limits. Make it exciting and shareable. Thank clients for spreading the word.

Write a job posting for a [POSITION: stylist, esthetician, nail tech, lash artist] at my [SALON/SPA/STUDIO]. About us: [BRIEF DESCRIPTION]. What we offer: [COMPENSATION, BENEFITS]. Who we're looking for: [QUALITIES, EXPERIENCE]. Include how to apply and what to include.

Write an outreach message to [BUSINESS TYPE: photographer, boutique, wedding planner, gym] proposing a collaboration. How we complement each other: [EXPLAIN]. Proposed collaboration: [IDEA - cross-promotion, package deal, event]. Benefits for both. Keep it friendly and low-pressure.

Write an inquiry email to [BRAND/DISTRIBUTOR] about carrying their products in my [SALON/SPA]. About my business: [BRIEF]. Why I'm interested in their products: [EXPLAIN]. Questions: wholesale pricing, minimum orders, training, exclusivity. Professional and interested tone.

Create a new client consultation form for [SERVICE TYPE - hair, skin, lash, nail]. Include: contact info, health/allergy questions relevant to service, current routine, goals/concerns, lifestyle factors, and consent/policy acknowledgment. Thorough but not overwhelming.

Write service menu descriptions for these services: [LIST SERVICES]. For each, include: brief description, what's included, duration, and benefit to client. Make them enticing and clear. Price can be added separately. Example: "Signature Facial - [description]"

Write a bio for a beauty professional. Name: [NAME]. Specialty: [SERVICES]. Experience: [YEARS, TRAINING]. Personal touch: [INTERESTS, WHY YOU LOVE YOUR WORK]. Ideal client: [DESCRIBE]. Tone: [WARM/EDGY/LUXURIOUS]. 100-150 words. First person or third person: [PREFERENCE].

Write a gift card promotion post for [OCCASION: Mother's Day, holidays, Valentine's Day, graduation]. Highlight: perfect gift, no expiration (if applicable), available amounts, bonus offer if running one (e.g., buy $100 get $20 free). Include purchasing instructions.

Write a post promoting my bridal/special event services. Services offered: [LIST]. What's included: [DESCRIBE]. Why book with me: [UNIQUE VALUE]. Booking timeline recommendation: [HOW FAR IN ADVANCE]. Beautiful and aspirational tone.

Write a response to a client complaint received via [DM/EMAIL/IN PERSON]. Issue: [DESCRIBE COMPLAINT]. My perspective: [YOUR SIDE]. Goal: resolve the issue and preserve the relationship if possible. Empathetic, professional, solution-focused.

Write a year-end thank you message to my clients. Reflect on: the year's highlights, gratitude for their support, excitement for next year. Include: holiday hours, any year-end promotions, and warm wishes. Genuine and heartfelt.
